// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execSync('prettier --write a.css && next');
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execSync("prettier a.css -w || next");
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execSync(`prettier --write a.css`);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
spawnSync('prettier', ['--write', 'a.css']);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execFileSync('prettier', ['a.css', '-w']);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
spawn('prettier', ["--write", 'a.css']);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execFile('prettier', ['a.css', '--write'], callback);
